title: ThermoPheno: Thermal-Time-Based Crop Phenology Simulation

creators.name: Eini, Mohammad Reza
creators.affiliation: Warsaw University of Life Sciences – SGGW

description: ThermoPheno is an R package and Shiny application for simulating crop planting, maturity, and harvest timing from daily minimum and maximum air temperatures. It supports simple, capped, and triangular thermal-time calculations; summer and winter crop workflows; temperature-based planting windows; baseline and observed-phenology calibration; climate-scenario comparison; and validation workflows. Bundled data include synthetic weather examples and an attributed extract of observed daily temperatures from the Deutscher Wetterdienst. Winter dormancy and vernalization are simplified; photoperiod, water stress, cultivar differences, and frost-kill processes are not explicitly represented. This software release does not establish predictive accuracy for a particular crop, site, or scenario.
